# forms

7 curated tools, plus 3 generated tools (Google Discovery parameter names; see `forms_discover`).

## `forms_batch_update`

Class: update

Generic forms.batchUpdate pass-through: add/edit/delete questions, update form info and settings. See https://developers.google.com/workspace/forms/api/reference/rest/v1/forms/request

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias |
| `formId` | string | required | Form ID |
| `requests` | array | required | Array of Request objects, each with one request-type key like {createItem: {...}} |
| `includeFormInResponse` | boolean | optional | Return the updated form in the response |
| `writeControl` | object | optional | Optional optimistic concurrency control |

## `forms_create`

Class: create

Create a new Google Form with a title (add questions with forms_batch_update)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias |
| `title` | string | required | Form title shown to responders |
| `documentTitle` | string | optional | Drive file name (default: the title) |

## `forms_get`

Class: read

Get a Google Form (definition: questions, sections, settings). Requires forms.body scope.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias; "*" = all accounts; omit for the default account |
| `formId` | string | required | Form ID |

## `forms_response_get`

Class: read

Get a single form response by ID

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias; "*" = all accounts; omit for the default account |
| `formId` | string | required | Form ID |
| `responseId` | string | required | Response ID |

## `forms_responses_list`

Class: read

List form responses. Requires forms.responses.readonly scope.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias; "*" = all accounts; omit for the default account |
| `formId` | string | required | Form ID |
| `pageSize` | number | optional | Default: 100; max 1000. Responses can be large. |
| `pageToken` | string | optional |  |
| `filter` | string | optional | Filter expression (e.g. "timestamp > 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z") |

## `forms_set_publish_settings`

Class: update

Publish/unpublish a form and toggle whether it accepts responses (legacy forms without publish state are not supported)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias |
| `formId` | string | required | Form ID |
| `isPublished` | boolean | required | Form is published and reachable by responders |
| `isAcceptingResponses` | boolean | optional | Form accepts responses (requires published; default: follows isPublished) |

## `forms_watches_list`

Class: read

List Pub/Sub watches on a form (notifications for new responses or schema changes)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias; "*" = all accounts; omit for the default account |
| `formId` | string | required | Form ID |
